{{Quote|And the time is indeed ended, Nuso Esva. Signal cherek, signal esk, signal krill.|Thrawn to Nuso Esva|<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''Cherek, esk, krill''' was a code phrase used by [[Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during a [[Battle of the Poln system|confrontation]] with the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] in the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]. Upon Thrawn's order to signal "cherek, esk, krill," a formation consisting of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], including [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and entered the system<ref name="COO" />
